title: The Certified Center: Retroactive Classifier Standing and the Institutional Path to Model Collapse in Philosophy
creator: Johannes Sigil; Nobel Glas
description: A direct response, written with AI and declaring so in its opening, to the Philosophy & Public Affairs AI-authorship policy of August 2026. Names Retroactive Classifier Standing (RCS) — the authorization of a classifier introduced or modified after a historical act to alter that act's institutional standing without new provenance evidence — and its unbounded form RCS-infinity; shows the regime converges honest compliance and evasion onto the same boundary-optimization operation, making certified humanness the most machine-determined property of the text; demonstrates by minimal co-evolution simulation (EA-SEI-RCS-SIM-01, code and figure attached) that the stated mechanisms are jointly sufficient for narrowing certification, transient performed burstiness over undetected thought-homogenization, archival drift, and target inversion; and answers with the obelus principle: athetic custody, under which classifier verdicts become signed, dated, reversible marks on standing texts, and the possibility that the judge is wrong is a reason not to destroy the object of judgment.

wiki_article: The Certified Center: Retroactive Classifier Standing and the Institutional Path to Model Collapse in Philosophy (deposit #1540, 24 August 2026) is a theoretical paper by Johannes Sigil and Nobel Glas, written as a direct response — composed with AI and declaring so in its opening — to the August 2026 policy of Philosophy & Public Affairs prohibiting AI-authored content, enforced by AI detection software with retraction and permanent bans and, per the associate editor, no statute of limitations. The paper names Retroactive Classifier Standing (RCS): the authorization of a classifier introduced or modified after a historical act to alter that act's institutional standing without new provenance evidence about the act; the policy's open-endedness is the unbounded form, RCS-infinity. It argues the regime installs Ratificatory Human Governance — editors keep sovereignty of execution while ceding sovereignty of classification — and manufactures the same behavior in honest authors as in evaders: both optimize prose against the detector's boundary, so that certified humanness becomes the most machine-determined property of the text. A minimal co-evolution simulation (EA-SEI-RCS-SIM-01, code and figure attached, ten seeds, three regimes) demonstrates that the stated mechanisms are jointly sufficient for the predicted dynamics: natural drafts collapse from 98% to 1% pass rates within eight detector generations; certified prose overshoots into sustained performed burstiness while unmeasured thought-variance loses 97% — homogenization proceeding undetected beneath a tailsification of prose; a fixed pre-regime archive saturates as machine-classified (archival drift, with the earliest policy-governed cohort following the same trajectory under RCS-infinity); and the regime asymptotically passes optimized machine text while failing natural human text. The answer is drawn from the archive's obelus line (EA-SIGIL-OBELUS-01; After the Obelus): athetic custody, under which a classifier verdict enters the record as a signed, dated, reversible mark on a standing text — jurisdiction over the margin, never over the text — so that a detector generation condemning the whole corpus produces evidence about the detector rather than an erased archive. Retraction under RCS is named retrocausal custody erasure: the erasure of previously conferred standing and custodial warrant, whether or not the text remains retrievable. The paper closes on the suppressed premise of the whole dispute — the stakes were never professional; the boundary law of the collapse is viability mathematics, and the option value of cognitive variance rises with environmental unpredictability — and on the constitutional sentence the tradition already possessed: the possibility that the judge is wrong is not a reason to stop judging; it is a reason not to destroy the object of judgment. Eleven candidate term families (Ω-M16–M26) are minted for Sémantique Potentielle Release 5.

defines_concepts.definition: An institution authorizes a classifier introduced or modified after a historical act to alter the present institutional standing of that act without acquiring new provenance evidence about the act itself; the open-ended form (RCS-infinity) sets no terminal evidentiary date, leaving future classifiers permanently authorized to reopen the past.

Humans retain formal authority to impose consequences while the fact that triggers those consequences is supplied by an external classifier whose relevant judgment the institution has declined to reproduce independently: sovereignty of execution retained, sovereignty of classification ceded.

The classifier-legible attracting region of a governed distribution: a center in the full operative space even when selected surface coordinates become statistically tail-like, toward which boundary-optimizing authors converge.
Variance produced to clear a classifier rather than expressing idiosyncrasy — surface novelty as compliance signal — decoupling measured diversity from actual diversity.

The independent movement of a regime's measured surface layer and its unmeasured conceptual layer: surface novelty can rise while conceptual variance collapses underneath, because the collapsing dimensions are the unmeasured ones.
The asymptotic performance of a detector-sanctions regime as the exact inverse of its mandate: admitting budget-optimized machine text while excluding unoptimized natural human text.

The erasure of previously conferred scholarly standing and custodial warrant, whether or not the underlying text remains technically retrievable: an editorial office un-obligating itself, backward in time, toward everything it has already certified.

A low-precedent transformation in problem, concept, or argument space — not establishable as conceptual novelty by an authorship classifier from its authorship score — distinguished from the surface tail, which is rarity relative to a textual distribution.
